rs-ms-average.front: How many prints should you measure?
rs-ms-average.back: 3 to 5 prints and several strides, then average. Animals change pace.

rs-ms-claws.front: Do claws count in track length?
rs-ms-claws.back: No. Claws register on and off, so they add error. Note them separately.

rs-ms-front-hind.front: Which print is bigger on a deer, front or hind?
rs-ms-front-hind.back: Front, slightly. Same for dogs and cats. Bears and hares: the hind is longer.

rs-ms-hare.front: Hare trail: where do the big hind feet land?
rs-ms-hare.back: Ahead of the small front feet. Hind feet are 2 to 4 times as long.

rs-ms-wolf-dog.front: Wolf or dog: the size rule?
rs-ms-wolf-dog.back: Front 10 cm (4 in) or more, or hind 9 cm (3.5 in) or more, no claws: likely wolf. 82% of dogs are smaller.
